purpose: P4a 4xRTX4090 without P2P or RDMA; 2P2D TP1. Validate all correctness/long/300-request gates before the single sglang_pd_r2 replay.
timeout_rationale: The 300-request trace preflight demonstrates a sustained arrival/service-rate mismatch. Align PD bootstrap/wait deadlines with the unchanged 3600-second client budget so CPU-staged transfer queueing is not mistaken for peer death.
concurrency_rationale: Keep the P3b default four sender shards. The initial one-shard developmental configuration caused head-of-line blocking between the two decode peers; queue admission is addressed by Mooncake capacities and deadlines instead.
